blocker.summary: The browser reconnect sends CampaignJoin (src/lib/campaign/coop/campaignSyncTransport.ts:205-216). An active member is routed to CampaignSyncSession.joinMember (src/lib/multiplayer/server/bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:1044-1058), which sends a safe folded baseline and then only events above the captured revision (CampaignSyncSession.ts:523-587). The room-code guest path sends a safe synthetic or replica snapshot and keeps grant catch-up ingest-only (handleRoomCodeGuestJoin.ts:236-271, roomCodeGuestLiveFanout.ts:79-104). A state-preserving launch fact at or below the cut therefore never reaches a cold guest on either path.
blocker.diagnostic: A registered campaign-scoped ParticipantRemoved fact committed through the journal was received live by a restricted guest; after private PilotHired history, a campaign checkpoint and an independent registry reopen, the same member received only a safe CampaignSnapshot and zero historical CampaignEvent frames.
blocker.red: red-confirmed: 10 failed / 37 passed on unchanged product code; archived eight-item inventory equal to HEAD
